topic: Handling frame lists for new campaigns
summary_markdown: The discussion focused on how to handle the list of available frames when a new campaign is created. It was decided that if no specific filters are applied, the system should not pass a list of frames. Instead, the endpoint must be called without passing frame parameters, even though the general audience data needs to be displayed.
decisions: When creating a new campaign with no filters, do not pass a list of frames to the API.
action_items: [p1] will start implementing the change regarding frame parameters.
